# Getting help

**Something is broken.** Open an [issue](https://github.com/rootSunc/CNEquity/issues/new/choose)
with the command you ran, the CNEquity version (`cne --version`), your operating system, and the
smallest configuration that reproduces it. Please redact local paths, proxy credentials, and tokens.

**A source changed or stopped answering.** Use the *source regression* issue template — it asks for
the dataset, the symptom, and the window, which is what makes the report actionable.

**You have a question or an idea.** Use
[Discussions](https://github.com/rootSunc/CNEquity/discussions) for usage questions, source
availability, and anything not yet scoped into a concrete change. A feature request lands better
when it explains the downstream research problem and the dataset or query contract you expect.

**You found a security issue.** Report it privately through
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) — never in a public issue or discussion.

Before filing, the [documentation site](https://rootsunc.github.io/CNEquity/) and the
[dataset catalog](https://rootsunc.github.io/CNEquity/datasets/catalog/) answer most questions
about coverage, adjustment semantics, and source limits.
